dedupe_keys.name: entso e cgmes library common grid model exchange standard and network code profile documents

description: The CGMES Library of ENTSO-E holds the documents approved by ENTSO-E or IEC for implementing the Common Grid Model Exchange Standard, the CIM-based format that European transmission operators use to exchange grid models for regional and pan-European development studies and operational processes required by the network codes. The library page read on 2026-09-26 lists updates from 2025 and 2026, among them Network Code profiles release 2.5 and the Regional Coordination Processes data exchange specification (10 September 2026), a boundary and common data exchange specification, an RDF syntax user guide, quality rules for CGMES datasets, UML of CGMES extensions, the ENTSO-E CIM UML and conformity attestations for software tools. It lists CGMES v2.4 and v3.0 with the IEC 61970 technical specifications they rely on, which are purchased from the IEC webstore, plus test configurations and the conformity assessment scheme. A CIM-based network model management document approved on 2 July 2026 incorporates CC BY-SA 4.0 material. Caveats: the core IEC texts are not free, and the library documents a format, not grid data. Simulation uses are importing and exporting operator grid models between tools and building model exchange pipelines for digital twins. Related records: data-iec-61970-301-common-information-model-cim covers the underlying CIM standard.
